hero.headline: Your punch card, in your customers' digital wallet
hero.subheadline: Customers scan a QR code once — the card lands straight in their Apple Wallet or Google Wallet. No app, no signup, and it updates itself with every stamp.
hero.ctaHint: Takes under a minute. No credit card required.

items.title: Customers keep coming back
items.body: The card lives in the wallet that's already on every phone — no app to install means no friction to earning your next visit.

items.title: No more lost sales from lost cards
items.body: Paper cards get torn, forgotten at home, or tossed. A digital card can't be left behind — every visit still counts.

items.title: Try it with zero risk
items.body: Design and preview exactly how your card will look, for free. You only pay once it's actually bringing customers back.

howItWorks.title: Three steps to your first customer

steps.title: Design your card
steps.body: Logo, colors, stamp count and reward — with a live preview that updates as you go.

steps.title: Customers scan a QR
steps.body: Once, no signup — and the card is already in their digital wallet.

steps.title: The card updates itself
steps.body: Every stamp updates in real time, right on the lock screen — no app, no hassle.

pricing.title: Start for free
pricing.body: Designing your card and dashboard costs nothing. Pay ₪59/month only when you activate the card for real customers.

footer.tagline: Digital loyalty for today's small businesses.
